scope: Actual Google Fonts browser requests; isolated synthetic consumers, not production pages

units.httpResponseBytes: Chromium CDP encoded response bytes; HTTP headers and encoded payload, excluding socket/TLS framing
units.httpDecodedBodyBytes: Cold response body after HTTP decompression; WOFF2 font data remains compressed as a font container
units.warmDecodedBody: Previous cold resource body size is retained for reference; it is not new network traffic

conditions: Separate fresh browser context for each cold page; immediate ordinary reload in that same context for warm phase; DNS/TLS/socket initialization is not measured
